snippet.title: Echo Punk - Official Gameplay Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
Echo Punk is an upcoming cyberpunk roguelite looter shooter where you clear collapsing layers of The Stack and push your limits with every descent.

Descend the Stack. Survive the Simulation.
How far can you go?

Wishlist Echo Punk on Steam!

Each level of The Stack collapses as you clear it, pulling you deeper into a high-intensity combat simulation built for precision mouse aim and adaptable playstyles.

⚙️ Features
• Fluid, skill-based combat tuned for mouse and keyboard
• Collapsing Stack levels with roguelite replayability
• Escalating challenge and adaptive AI behavior
• Customizable controls for personalized playstyles

Developed by Midnight Gamers, a sibling-run indie studio building worlds at the edge of code and chaos.
